title: 4th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/2/2025).

Matter submitted under Rule 201 of the Majlis Standing Orders by Keyodhoo MP Mohamed Niushad for debate on the difficulties businesses face because of how the law sets the time at which GST becomes payable.

Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the resolution submitted by Baarah MP Ibrahim Shujau to gauge the views of 20th Majlis members on the amendments made to Law No. 7/2010 (Decentralisation Act) in the 15 years since it came into force, and on the difficulties and challenges faced in running the decentralised system.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting debated a member's matter on how the GST payment timing rules burden businesses and continued the debate on the resolution reviewing 15 years of the Decentralisation Act.
